eip155_chain_id.issue: Pin the unique production Gnosis EIP-155 chain ID in an authenticated activation record.

eez_rollup_id.issue: Pin the unique production Gnosis EEZ rollup ID.

native_asset.issue: Pin the production native asset and its custody and backing semantics.

genesis_commitment.issue: Publish the exact production genesis artifact, artifact digest, state root, block hash, allocations, and validation vectors.

evm_fork.issue: Pin the complete production EVM fork schedule and every fork-dependent chain parameter.

eez_contract.issue: Pin the Ethereum EEZ address, runtime-code hash, deployment transaction, and proxy implementation where applicable.

manager_contract.issue: Pin the Ethereum Gnosis manager address, runtime-code hash, deployment transaction, and authority configuration.

manager_proof_context.issue: Pin MANAGER(n): the exact recent Ethereum block-number rule, getCustomData(uint64) encoding, canonical block-hash authentication, and failure behavior.

proof_system_contracts.issue: Pin every Ethereum validity and authorization proof-contract address, runtime-code hash, verification key, and public-input layout.

deployment_block.issue: Pin the canonical Ethereum deployment and activation block numbers and hashes and the first governed Gnosis block.

value.candidate_rule: Apply only a candidate for which the activated Ethereum settlement path verifies complete Gnosis validity and the Gnosis authorization proof contract verifies the required sequencer/composer signature over the same candidate.
value.ordering: Process successful applications in canonical Ethereum execution order. The first authorized valid candidate whose exact parent height, block hash, and state root equal the live settled cursor wins.
value.stale_rule: A later candidate that names a replaced parent is stale and does not advance Gnosis state, even when its parent root equals the current root.
value.relay_rule: Any relayer may submit the exact authorized and proven batch.

finality_rule.value: A deterministically derived Gnosis block is safe after complete replay of canonical Ethereum settlement evidence and finalized when the containing Ethereum history is finalized. Reorganizations follow rollup0-common-execution@0.2-draft §6.3; recovery outside the activated automatic history uses the selected governance procedure.
finality_rule.source: Gnosis Chain EEZ Network Specification §1.4; rollup0-common-execution@0.2-draft §6.3

block_gas_limit.issue: Pin the production genesis gas limit and its complete per-block transition rule.

header_construction.issue: Pin every production Gnosis header field, parent-derived transition, fixed constant, fork-dependent presence rule, body commitment, execution-environment input, and complete validation procedure.

fee_market.issue: Pin the production transaction and data fee markets, genesis parameters, accounting, and validation rules.

fee_recipient.issue: Pin the production fee recipient and fee distribution or burn rules.

eez_predeploys.issue: Pin every Gnosis EEZ predeploy address, runtime-code hash, initial storage commitment, and deployment rule.

system_address.issue: Pin the Gnosis system address, authorization mechanism, funding rule, and activation boundary.

system_address_safety.issue: Pin and implement a system-address design that cannot execute user code, prevents reentrant table replacement, enforces one inbound call per transaction, and fails closed.

system_transaction_envelope.issue: Pin the exact deterministic system-transaction envelope and positive and negative vectors compatible with eez-evm@0.2-draft.

value.acceptance_rule: A candidate is accepted only when it extends the live settled parent, satisfies every Gnosis and EEZ validity rule, and carries the activated sequencer/composer authorization verified by the Gnosis authorization proof contract.
value.invalid_candidate_rule: Reject an invalid candidate even when an authorized signer signed it; authorization never replaces validity.

mode.source: Gnosis Chain EEZ Network Specification §§1.3 and 2.2-2.3

parameters.issue: Pin the signature envelope, canonical candidate encoding, digest, replay domain, accepted signature form, signer identity rule, verification algorithm, authorization-set rule, and vectors.

value.ordering_rule: Use canonical Ethereum contract-execution order, never mempool arrival, signature time, proof time, peer count, or candidate hash.
value.conflict_rule: The first applicable candidate that passes full validity and active authorization wins even when another authorized signer signed a competing valid candidate.
value.stale_candidate_rule: After a winner advances the settled cursor identity, reject every later candidate that names the old parent as inapplicable, including equal-root siblings.

value.authorization_rule: Authorization applies to the candidate signer, not to the Ethereum transaction sender.
value.submission_rule: Any account or contract may submit the exact authorized and proven batch.
value.failure_rule: Reject a modified, stale, invalid, unauthorized, or incompletely proven batch; do not reserve a conforming batch for a preferred relayer.

proof_budget_ms.issue: Pin the production candidate-construction and proof budget P in milliseconds.

submission_slack_ms.issue: Pin the production submission lead time S in milliseconds.

max_catch_up_blocks.issue: Pin C, the producer-side maximum blocks emitted at one catch-up trigger; C is not a candidate-range validity bound.

l1_l2_lowering.issue: Pin the deterministic field-by-field lowering from each supported settlement/execution action to its distinct L1 entry, L2 sidecar object, explicit inbound arguments, and exact system transaction, with rejection vectors.

max_candidate_range_blocks.issue: Pin N_max, the positive maximum number of execution-network blocks allowed in any candidate range as a consensus validity bound.

cursor_applicability.issue: Pin an enforceable settlement mechanism that compares the candidate's exact parent height, block hash, and state root with the current settled cursor and atomically advances to the authenticated selected prefix endpoint identity, including when roots repeat.

applied_prefix_safety.issue: Pin an enforceable mechanism that prevents a non-applied anchor or effect from allowing a later effect to apply, including when consecutive effects have repeated or equal root values.

atomic_inclusion.issue: Pin the Ethereum mechanism that provides the complete ordered settlement operation required by the imported execution rules, including exact failure and partial-inclusion detection.

max_user_transactions_per_bundle.issue: Pin the production bundle capacity after measuring proof, gas, DA, and relay limits.

proof_routing_mitigation.issue: Bind the relayer-independent candidate authorization to the exact effective batch, both transient prefix counts, settlement contracts, proofs, and all routing fields; prevent modified proof or signature reuse and front-running.

model.issue: Pin the production validity proof model and the additional candidate-authorization statement verified on Ethereum.

allowed_proof_systems_and_vkeys.issue: Pin the allowed proof systems, verification keys, contract deployments, code hashes, and activation epochs.

threshold.issue: Pin the validity proof threshold independently of the candidate-signature threshold.

requirement.value: Publish all user transactions and canonical L2 execution sidecars required for independent replay under rollup0-common-execution@0.2-draft.
requirement.source: Gnosis Chain EEZ Network Specification §1.2; rollup0-common-execution@0.2-draft §§3 and 6

derivation_rule.value: Apply the complete canonical evidence, exact-prefix repair, replay, commit, reorganization, and safety-label rules in rollup0-common-execution@0.2-draft §6.

manager_authority.issue: Pin the initial authorized sequencer/composer set, its threshold and custody, and every manager or governance authority that can change admission or proof policy.

upgrade_policy.issue: Pin signer addition, removal, compromise, suspension, and rotation rules together with upgrade delays, activation boundaries, historical verification, and reorg behavior.

reorg_and_emergency_rule.issue: Pin Ethereum and Gnosis reorg bounds, emergency actions, authenticated recovery activations, authority thresholds, and the prohibition on reinterpreting finalized history.
